test_tool_hash_scope: Protocol and isolation execution reports provide hashes checked against current inputs. The full host runner records firmware fingerprint and logs; current_test_tool_sha256 captures other tools at export time.
limitations: No physical UNIT board, real RS485 electrical/turnaround timing or installed AnyEyes user-interface acceptance test.
Electronic tags select matching product configuration; full-FF universal connection is retained and is not authentication.
FA/7A is a completed SST response using the reference reserved command IDs; host support for it still requires UI verification.
Queued transport frames are preserved at reconnect; ResetSession cancels unqueued tasks and subscriptions, not control run commands.
The saved user configuration enables bench inputs by default; disabling SST_BENCH_INPUT_SIM restores hardware sampling. Bench input generation is not a power-circuit dynamic model.

Source and normalized ISR assembly isolation do not prove hardware interrupt latency or the 100 us deadline. The bench waveform calculation still requires physical timing and missed-interrupt measurements.
This export validates existing reports and hashes; it does not rebuild or rerun behavioral suites.
The planned delivery tag and firmware fingerprint identify the final delivery without a self-referential final commit hash.
